title: Nepal Rasuwa Catastrophic Landslide 2026
title_zh: 尼泊尔热索瓦（Rasuwa）特大泥石流灾害
region: Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan districts along the Trishuli River; impacts reach the China–Nepal Gyirong–Rasuwagadhi border crossing
region_zh: 热索瓦、努瓦果德、塔丁、廓尔喀、奇特旺（特里苏里河沿岸），波及中尼吉隆—拉苏瓦堡口岸一侧
summary: On the morning of 26 August 2026, a catastrophic debris flow struck Rasuwa district in northern Nepal, triggering cascading river-bank disasters along the Trishuli River with heavy casualties and infrastructure loss. The Nepali side of the Gyirong–Rasuwagadhi border crossing with China was severely hit, and many foreign trekkers and Nepali citizens remain missing. The Government of Nepal has activated its highest-level emergency response; the Army, Police and Armed Police Force are fully engaged in search and rescue, with coordinated China–Nepal verification and relief efforts under way.
summary_zh: 2026年8月26日上午，尼泊尔北部热索瓦地区发生大规模泥石流并引发沿河次生灾害，特里苏里河沿岸多地出现重大人员伤亡和财产损失。中国吉隆—尼泊尔拉苏瓦堡口岸尼方一侧受灾严重，大量外籍游客与尼泊尔公民失联。尼泊尔政府已启动最高级应急响应，军队、警察、武装警察部队全面投入搜救，中尼两侧正协同开展搜救与核实工作。

updates.text: Search and rescue continues; Nepal's weather department forecasts further rain in the north in coming days, challenging road access and relief. Casualty figures may still rise.
updates.text_zh: 搜救持续推进；尼气象部门预计未来数日北部仍有降雨，道路通行与救援面临挑战，伤亡数字可能进一步上升。

updates.text: Nepal Police: at least 289 dead and 910 missing (including hundreds of foreign trekkers). The disaster has damaged 35 vehicle bridges, 45 suspension bridges and 40 km of paved road.
updates.text_zh: 尼泊尔警方通报：遇难人数升至至少 289 人、910 人失联（含数百名外籍游客）。灾害已致 35 座可通车桥梁、45 座吊桥和 40 公里铺装道路受损。

updates.text: China MFA: the debris flow caused heavy casualties and missing persons on both the Chinese and Nepali sides; per Gyirong (Tibet) authorities, 260 foreign nationals are missing in the affected area; ~100 Chinese citizens missing on the Nepali side, with the Chinese Embassy in Nepal verifying further.
updates.text_zh: 外交部：泥石流造成中尼两国重大人员伤亡和失联；据西藏吉隆发布信息，受灾地区失联外国公民 260 人；尼方一侧失联中国公民近百人，中国驻尼使馆正进一步核实。

updates.text: Nepal Police: death toll rises to at least 270.
updates.text_zh: 尼泊尔警方：遇难人数升至至少 270 人。

updates.text: The Government of Nepal activates emergency response, ordering the Army, Police, Armed Police Force and local governments into full SAR and relief, reopening roads and restoring water, power and telecom; several affected local administrative units are declared disaster-crisis areas for 3 months.
updates.text_zh: 尼泊尔政府启动应急响应，要求军队、警察、武装警察部队及地方政府全面投入搜救救灾，尽快抢通道路、恢复供水供电通信；并将部分受灾地方行政单位划为灾害危机地区，期限 3 个月。

updates.text: Nepal Tourism Board initial count: 384 trekkers missing (291 foreigners, 93 Nepalis); the list is being cross-checked with agencies, guides, local governments and security forces. At least 17 confirmed dead.
updates.text_zh: 尼泊尔旅游委员会初步统计：384 名游客失联（含 291 名外国人和 93 名尼泊尔人），名单正与旅行社、导游、地方政府及安全机构交叉核查。灾害已致至少 17 人死亡。

updates.text: A massive debris flow strikes Rasuwa district in northern Nepal; riverside areas suffer multiple impacts, the Rasuwagadhi crossing side is badly damaged, roads and power infrastructure destroyed, several hydropower plants shut down.
updates.text_zh: 尼泊尔北部热索瓦地区突发大规模泥石流，沿河多地受灾，拉苏瓦堡口岸一侧受损严重，道路、电力等基础设施遭破坏，多座水电站停发。
